scope: Broker/account/lifecycle/persistence implementation evidence; not broker parity or a complete project release certificate
target_semantics: Freeze half of initial executed gross maximum; actual managed net realization must reach that same dollar amount

implemented.evidence: First launch and doctor share actual import, timezone, project environment, local runtime write/read/fsync/delete, disk reserve, supported schema/rule and bounded archive/pack-metadata checks. Nonmodal setup diagnostics guide only unmet configuration. Missing/unqualified models never block browsing or explicit demo. Pack metadata availability is explicitly distinct from full artifact/capability verification.

Each prescribed price/Greek validation point tests intrinsic and European lower bounds, call/negative-rate put upper bounds, spot and strike monotonicity, convexity and nonnegative Vega using independent reference uncertainty and explicit polynomial arithmetic error. Failing financial cells refine without clipping. Five signed residual samples along each central axis select width-normalized refinement with x,w,a,b ties; per-cell financial audits persist.

Immutable V2 HOLD labels retain first-hit counts and add32 deterministic optional deadlines selected only from the original frozen observation grid. Loss weights independent path counts, includes within-bin CDF MSE and gives an unobserved conditional terminal head zero survivor weight. Independent-case held-out within-bin gates use simultaneous Wilson and numerical uncertainty, retain separate edge-family results, and re-evaluate predictions from loaded model bytes. Legacy labels require explicit unqualified compatibility.

Typed signed ratio-unit orders, natural sides, exact package ticks, every-leg later-quote gating, worst-case timestamp uncertainty, non-reused quote depth, conditional total-fee/risk/capital gates, cancellation and DAY/GTC handling
Cumulative Decimal groups, per-order/leg opening commission caps, trade-date charge groups, fixed-rule TAF waiver, sale proceeds Section31, cent allocation and delivery batch charges

Exact payoff knots/tails, cash collateral templates including unequal condor wings, bounded deterministic allocation with proof/budget abstention, component entry commitments and separate NLV/collateral/reservation/BP fields

Signed FIFO lot basis, economic versus settled cash, idempotent obligations, fixed target initialization after full/canceled-subset fills, explicit financing, historical settlement lag function and scenario banking calendar

Four physical-delivery signs, basis transfer, explicit assignment and expiry scenarios, official/proxy distinction, long instructions and funding review, delayed notice clocks, dividend revisions, named preselected risk review and typed historical-rule refusal
Protected-delivery lower bounds, sum-of-wings operational versus max-wing terminal collateral, remaining expense sub-reserve, cumulative campaign/session loss tests and no-fill preservation

SQLite WAL/FULL, unique commands/events, all-or-nothing transactions, canonical event chains, durable commit state events, verified checkpoint recovery, parent-bound branches, backup API and frozen exports. Pre-COMMIT failure rolls back; lost acknowledgment after COMMIT recognizes the durable command. Unknown schemas are rejected before changing journal mode. Restores reject added/removed bound-session partitions and altered source/parameter/calendar/normalization/pack identities.

Actual initialization event freezes original lots, all prior partial-fill cash/fees, target, deadlines, event-time inclusive market snapshot and original model/rule identity. Qualified coherent input becomes PENDING and is inferred asynchronously from immutable inputs. Immutable idempotent benchmark results preserve p0_hold, evaluated frozen-policy p0_policy and empirical range. Missing or unsupported original inputs remain UNKNOWN with reason; later observations are not substituted.

Synthetic openings and 0-3 declared subsequent actions use the actual Broker ledger. Each next-opportunity fill/nonfill preserves original target, cumulative costs, position ownership and conditional constraints. Full term-surface design admits up to eight expiries and 512 contracts, reconstructs observable ATM path sigma, preserves RNG state and exclusions, and derives closed-observation state from an earlier eligible fill. Fast frozen-policy selection uses the separate scorer encoder and mandatory final-opportunity liquidation.

Canonical held-position analysis is distinct from an adjustment proposal. Stale selection results and errors are gated. ProcessPoolExecutor crash recovery creates a fresh spawned worker; benchmark futures are independent of draft-selection cancellation. Restore/order/export ordering is deterministic, and exported bar labels name actual completed candles.

Live forecast admission preserves exact holdings, bounds optional observed contracts to512/eight expiries, records every search omission and excludes unseen or newly extending expiries beyond the frozen hard cutoff. Actual last-trading times and measured half-spreads survive the adapters. HOLD keeps its original market law; managed forecasts and initial policy benchmarks use a separately frozen nearest-hard-cutoff expiry anchor, with complete audit and managed-only abstention when unavailable.

measured_subset.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_account_broker.py tests/test_storage_events.py tests/test_lifecycle_integration.py tests/test_replay_integration.py tests/test_account_analysis_inputs.py tests/test_account_risk_adapter.py tests/test_analysis_worker_recovery.py tests/test_account_design.py tests/test_account_benchmarks.py -q --basetemp=runtime/test-account

additional_review_runs.evidence: Actual startup import/timezone/write checks, missing DLL and low-disk/write failure diagnostics, unchanged read-only source bytes, optional missing/unqualified pack handling, both app.launch nonmodal paths, preserved synthetic launch, doctor identity keys and read-only saved-export CLI routing.

Final integrated current-source check of account execution fields, survival-label/loss/within-bin qualification, numeric training persistence, compiled source evidence, price financial inequalities/face gates/saved tree, and builder recovery. Offline validation also enforces actual ModelPack feature/network qualification contracts before allowing a qualified result.

Exact preview and modeled account transitions preserve order type and DAY/GTC, reject unsupported enum values, and expire delayed DAY orders before next-session fills. Per-regime uncertainty ranges and qualification gates use the maximum of headline and sampled within-bin conservative errors.

Path-weighted loss, stable extreme hazards/zero counts, immutable grid labels, early versus late same-bin hits, empty-survivor behavior, schema migration, case-level held-out uncertainty and loaded-byte within-bin rejection despite correct headline predictions.

Each financial inequality independently rejects a violated polynomial; valid analytical prices and a controlled exercise cell pass. Negative-rate upper bounds and independently propagated uncertainty are retained. Residual central-axis variation, deterministic ties and financial-failure refinement are verified. This run preceded the subsequently added requested-domain cache hook.

Simulated compiled modules without .py files or function __code__ preserve exact source identities and checkpoint resumption. Online import audits parse embedded source text verified against build-time SHA256, detect forbidden imports, and refuse missing/tampered evidence. Build capture preserves CRLF bytes and detects a source change during manifest generation. This is a compiled-mode regression, not a standalone executable smoke result.
Hashed shard aggregate receipts, exact integer shapes and count/histogram/terminal/disagreement conservation, valid resumed results, fixed NumPy write buffers and typed oversized-record refusal
Mandatory validation-only edge families, reserved expiry universes, actual opening/partial-close ledgers and verified terminal topology

Causal multi-expiry and oversized-chain admission, true expiry/stop metadata, unchanged HOLD versus separately anchored managed law, actual measured spread preservation, original benchmark inference routing and frozen pack identity. This run overlaps earlier subsets; counts are not additive.

required_runtime_inputs: Verified contract metadata and causal quotes for the chosen historical session
Complete effective-dated records for historical broker equivalence; included production-default rules are expressly fixed-rule counterfactual
Official fixing or explicitly selected proxy scenario for physical expiry
Explicit assignment notices and knowledge times when replaying assignment scenarios
Announced dividend fields and financing/borrow inputs when stock obligations persist
Actual stock quotes for execution of stock reductions; underlying OHLC close is only a mark
conditional_or_unqualified: No account-specific broker parity, tax reporting, portfolio margin, SMA, leveraged naked-option permission or adjusted deliverable support is claimed
Historical rule registry validates local complete records; the desktop initial configuration continues to refuse unprovided historic profile data
Finite supported assignment scenarios and the explicit atomic-protection certificate do not cover arbitrary hidden notice lag or unbounded future financing
The 84-test subset is not all APP/SRC-E/SRC-D gates, a numerical pack qualification, or a clean Windows release test
The initial-benchmark workflow tests inject a controlled qualification adapter to test persistence and identity; they do not qualify any production probability pack
Archive-derived execution uses a declared simulation of atomic combo fills and optional size-unverified liquidity
